request.question: My email is jane.doe@example.com and my phone is 415-555-0134. How do I request time off in lieu after a weekend on-call shift?

response.answer: Engineers receive one day of time off in lieu for every weekend on-call shift. [1] Time off in lieu must be used within 60 days and is requested through Workday. [1] The primary on-call engineer must acknowledge pages within 5 minutes during their shift. [2] On-call engineers should keep a laptop and a stable internet connection available at all times during their shift. [2]
